title: SOLD: Slot Object-Centric Latent Dynamics Models for Relational Manipulation Learning from Pixels
summary: SOLD is a model-based reinforcement learning method that learns object-centric, slot-based latent dynamics from pixels without supervision. It outperforms DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2 on robot tasks that need relational reasoning and manipulation.
